operations.description: Add positive PF2e pp/gp/sp/cp amounts through inventory.addCurrency and verify the copper-value change. Item currency is managed by PF2e. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Decrease one valued PF2e condition step or remove an explicit condition through the system API. Verifies the observed remaining condition. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
Read an Actor document and its unmodified pf2e system data. Does not calculate game rules or roll dice.

actor_uuid.description: Actor UUID in the selected target world.

operations.description: Read PF2e prepared Actor level, abilities, HP, armor class, traits, movement and resources. Does not recalculate rules outside PF2e.
Read PF2e conditions including value, active/overridden state, locked grants and temporary conditions.
Read PF2e inventory.currency denomination amounts and system-computed copper value.
Read PF2e physical inventory and system-computed bulk. Unidentified item names and values are hidden from non-GMs.
Read an existing numeric PF2e resource by exact slug, such as focus or hero-points.
Read PF2e spellcasting entries, prepared slot data and associated spells. Does not cast spells or consume slots.
Read a PF2e statistic by its exact slug, including lore and system-prepared custom statistics.
List PF2e prepared skills, lore, saves and perception with modifiers and DCs; contextual roll results may differ.
List prepared PF2e strikes and MAP variants. Re-read before rolling; index plus exact item UUID protects against reordered actions.

Increase a valued PF2e condition using the system condition API and verify the resulting value. Rejects locked or temporary conditions. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Recharge PF2e frequencies/resources for turn, round or daily preparation via Actor.recharge({commit:true}). Daily preparation can restore spell slots; this is not a full rest or healing operation. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Remove PF2e currency through inventory.removeCurrency, optionally making change. Checks funds and verifies the resulting total; compound updates are not atomic. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll the prepared PF2e perception Statistic without opening its modifier dialog. This does not update encounter initiative. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll fortitude, reflex or will with the live PF2e Statistic API. A supplied DC is numeric; contextual spell/origin options are not inferred. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll a prepared PF2e skill or lore through its live Statistic API, including predicates, stacking and degree of success. May publish chat and trigger rule hooks. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll an exact existing PF2e statistic slug through its runtime method; no caller formula, arbitrary method or modifiers are evaluated. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Roll one prepared PF2e strike/MAP variant against an explicit rendered target token. Requires disabled check dialogs for the paired user. May consume ammunition and consumable weapons; does not apply damage. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Set an explicit PF2e condition presence through Actor.toggleCondition({active}); never blindly toggle. Persistent damage editors and locked/temporary grants are excluded. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.

Set an existing PF2e numeric resource through updateResource; validates bounds and checks the observed value. Investiture is read-only. WRITE: requires the selected target's writeEnabled=true and OWNER permission on the Actor (or a GM runtime). An outcome_unknown result must not be retried automatically.
